title: Tooltip - Gold
description: Changes Minecraft default tooltip to a new golden tooltip.
body:
# Texture

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e429b3dbb56e55450d91aece8b0d4ae61adf7bf.png)

A visual enhancement that replaces the default Minecraft tooltip with a refined golden frame and matching background, designed to look premium while staying easy to read.

This pack focuses purely on improving the look and feel of tooltips, giving them a polished, high-quality appearance that fits naturally into the Minecraft UI.
